set.body:
Problem: tools/ci/full-repository-tests.sh omits estimates, estimatesIo, fitEstimates and providerSpike JVM/JS targets present in scalafimTestAll.
Files: tools/ci/full-repository-tests.sh, tools/ci/first-level-gate.sh, a new tools/ci/check_test_inventory.py and stdlib unittest file; build.sbt is the source inventory, not a second hard-coded allowlist.
Steps:
1. Add omitted portable targets to small, named batches. Split the focused first-level script into bounded sbt invocations too; do not invoke scalafimTestAll as one process.
2. Add --check and --print-batches inventory modes. Compare the actual release batches with the scalafimTestAll target set; fail for missing, duplicate, or unknown targets. Keep explicit, documented JavaFX/display exclusions and separately list extra example tests.
3. Wire the fast inventory check into the focused gate. Preserve nonzero exit propagation.
Acceptance: Python stdlib tests cover missing estimates target, duplicate target, unknown target, legitimate display exclusion and extra examples. Run python3 -S tools/ci/check_test_inventory.py --check, its unittest suite, and bash -n on both scripts. Run estimatesJVM/estimatesIoJVM/fitEstimatesJVM tests and their JS counterparts in separate bounded invocations. Whole-repository execution belongs to P4.4j.
Scope: no dependency pin changes, no numerical threshold changes, no claiming excluded platforms passed.
set.title: P4.4a: synchronize bounded test batches with the supported module inventory
